blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — A few individuals visited their departed loved ones at cemeteries in Barangay Guizo, Mandaue City, on Friday, October 30, ahead of the expected influx of visitors over the coming days. There are four cemeteries in Barangay Guizo, including St. Joseph Roman Catholic Cemetery, the largest public cemetery in the area. Some visitors said they chose to visit early to avoid the anticipated crowds, while others planned to travel to their respective provinces to pay their respects to their departed loved ones. “Para malikay lang sa dugok sa mga tawo, niya init sad panahon.
